# 717. 1-bit and 2-bit Characters

## Solution 1 (time O(n), space O(1))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def isOneBitCharacter(self, bits):
        """
        :type bits: List[int]
        :rtype: bool
        """
        n = len(bits)
        p = 0
        while p < n - 1:
            p += bits[p] + 1
        return p == n - 1
```
